title: Universal 3D Model Spec
description: Declarative description of a 3D model, scene and render. An LLM writes this JSON; a trusted builder converts it to Blender objects. Units: meters. Axes: Z up, right-handed. Angles: degrees. Colors: linear 0-1. All cross-references (parent, operand, source, material, texture_id...) use ids defined in this same document or in the library.

textures.description: Texture assets (PBR map sets) available to materials.

objects.description: All geometry in the model. Order does not matter; use 'parent' for hierarchy.

duplicates.description: Pattern-based copies of objects (rows, rings, grids, explicit placements).

id.description: Lowercase identifier: letters, digits, underscore. Starts with a letter.

relPath.description: Relative local file path inside the asset folder. No URLs, no '..'.

lookTarget.description: A world-space point [x,y,z] or the id of an object to look at.

description.description: Natural-language description. This is the text that gets embedded for vector search.

based_on.description: Ids of library designs this model was adapted from.

faceSelector.description: Chooses faces in the object's local space.

edgeSelector.description: Chooses edges in the object's local space.

dimensions.description: Bounding-box size [x, y, z] in meters. Cylinder/cone: [diameter_x, diameter_y, height]. Plane/circle: z is ignored.

top_ratio.description: Cone only: top radius as a fraction of bottom radius (0 = pointed).

tube_ratio.description: Torus only: tube thickness as a fraction of the major radius.

profile.description: A 2D outline turned into 3D by extruding, lathing (spinning) or sweeping along a curve object.

points.description: Ordered 2D points. For lathe: [radius, height] pairs, starting on the axis (radius 0) when you want a solid.

depth.description: Extrude mode only. Extrudes from the profile plane along its right-handed normal: XY goes toward +Z, XZ toward -Y, YZ toward +X. The profile sits at the object's origin, so offset the object's location to center the result.

path.description: Id of a curve object to sweep along.

bevel_depth.description: Tube radius in meters. 0 gives a bare line (not renderable).

customMesh.description: Raw mesh data. Use only for simple polygons; prefer primitives, profiles and operations for anything complex.

faces.description: Each face is a list of 3-8 vertex indices, counter-clockwise when viewed from outside.

empty.description: A transform-only node, used to group and move several objects together.

operation.description: Mesh edit applied in order, after the base shape is created and before modifiers.

distance.description: Meters along face normal. Negative = intrude.

depth.description: Negative pushes the inset face inward (recess).

modifier.description: Non-destructive modifier applied in order, after operations.

relative_offset.description: Offset as a multiple of object size.

constant_offset.description: Offset in meters. Overrides relative_offset when present.

operand.description: Id of the object used as the cutter or addend.

collection.description: Optional group name for organizing objects.

parent.description: Id of the parent object. Must not form a cycle.

material.description: Material id applied to the whole object.

real_world_size_m.description: Physical size covered by one texture tile, in meters. Lets the builder keep wood grain and tiles at a realistic scale.

source.description: Id of the object to copy.

rotate_copies.description: Turn each copy to face outward.

auto_frame.description: Builder positions the camera so the whole model fits. Recommended for LLM output.

margin.description: Extra space around the model when auto-framing (1 = tight).

energy.description: Watts for point/spot/area. Strength (W/m2) for sun.

size_m.description: Area light edge length or point/spot radius.

shadow_catcher.description: Invisible floor that only shows shadows (use with a transparent background).

lighting_preset.description: Ready-made lighting rig added before any explicit lights.

exposure.description: EV stops. Raise if the image is dark, lower if washed out.

film_transparent.description: Transparent background in the output image.

timeout_s.description: Hard limit for the render job.

include_scene.description: Include camera and lights where the format supports them.
